title: 106th Rescue Wing March Team Rescue TV
description:
The 106th Rescue Wing produces its monthly news broadcast Team Rescue TV at Francis S. Gabreski Air National Guard Base, Westhampton Beach, N.Y., March 1, 2024. Team Rescue TV is the 106th's monthly news broadcast that informs the Wing on events and training conducted throughout each month. (U.S. Air National Guard video by Captain Cheran Campbell, Technical Sgt. Daniel Farrell, Technical Sgt. Sean Madden, Technical Sgt. Kevin Donaldson, and Senior Airman Sarah McKernan)
(Women’s History Month video by Airman 1st Class Alysa Calvarese, downloaded from DVIDS. Video ID: 878097)

Women's History Month is a continued
celebration of women all over the world .
In March , we reflect on the
contributions that women have made to
history and for our future . It
is aimed at recognizing the women who
have come before us and those that are
currently choosing to make a difference .
Those that inspire That work hard That
are dedicated And choose to put others
before themselves . We follow in the
footsteps of women that came before us
and empower those to follow .
Women's History Month is about
celebrating women from different walks
of life . And those with their own
empowering stories of what this month
means to them . To the women that
continue to shape our future , we thank
you .
